raw_text: The sabotage of an Oil India Limited crude oil pipeline in Assam's Tinsukia district has highlighted the vulnerability of India's energy infrastructure in the northeast. The ULFA-I attack using IEDs at two valve stations along the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor caused a major environmental disaster with crude oil contaminating 12 hectares of wetland. Energy sector analysts note this is the most significant attack on northeast India's oil infrastructure in recent years.
clean_text: OIL pipeline sabotage in Tinsukia highlights northeast energy infrastructure vulnerability. ULFA-I IED attack caused 12-hectare wetland contamination. Most significant oil infrastructure attack in recent years.
